title: Woman Runs From Police After Assaulting Boyfriend
description:
Start a completely FREE trial with our sponsor Aura and protect yourself from getting scammed: https://www.aura.com/insider 

On May 21st, 2022, officers responded to a report of a woman who had assaulted her boyfriend and vandalized his car. By the time the cops arrived, she had run away. Her boyfriend advised that she had a gun with her and also had self-harming tendencies. She had run and gotten under a parked bus in order to avoid the police. She got out from under the bus, ran and once again got under a trailor. Later that day, she was cleared from the hospital and transported to the jail. She was charged with Aggravated Assault and Battery Against a Household Member, resisting law enforcement and criminal damage to property.
